name: Intercom
description: An AI-first customer service platform providing messaging, help desk, and automation tools for businesses.

evidence.claim: Intercom supports OAuth2 for public apps and Access Tokens for private apps.
A free development workspace is available for developers to build and test integrations.
Intercom has an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
The API covers a wide range of resources including Contacts, Conversations, Tickets, Articles, and Data Events.
Intercom provides regional API endpoints for US, Europe, and Australia.

notes: Intercom provides a dedicated free development workspace for building and testing integrations. OAuth is mandatory for public apps, while access tokens are used for private workspace integrations.
